steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest: choose the meaning (3 min)
steps.instructions: Review words from P3 (10): major in = học chuyên ngành · pursue = theo đuổi · internship = đợt thực tập · hands-on = thực hành, làm trực tiếp · deadline = hạn chót · acquire = tiếp thu, đạt được (kỹ năng) · flexible = linh hoạt · passionate about = đam mê · fulfilling = mang lại cảm giác ý nghĩa, thỏa mãn · overwhelmed = quá tải, choáng ngợp. Choose the correct meaning (A, B, C or D) for each word.

items.explain: pursue = theo đuổi. Example: She wants to pursue a career in tourism.
deadline = hạn chót. Example: I always try to meet the deadline for my assignments.

options.B: mang lại cảm giác ý nghĩa, thỏa mãn

items.explain: hands-on = thực hành, làm trực tiếp. Example: I prefer hands-on learning to long lectures.
major in = học chuyên ngành. Example: I major in Business at a university in Hanoi.
overwhelmed = quá tải, choáng ngợp. Example: I felt overwhelmed in my first week at university.

options.C: mang lại cảm giác ý nghĩa, thỏa mãn

items.explain: acquire = tiếp thu, đạt được (kỹ năng). Example: Students acquire new skills through group projects.

options.C: mang lại cảm giác ý nghĩa, thỏa mãn

items.explain: fulfilling = mang lại cảm giác ý nghĩa, thỏa mãn. Example: Teaching children is a fulfilling job.
internship = đợt thực tập. Example: He did a three-month internship at a bank.

options.C: mang lại cảm giác ý nghĩa, thỏa mãn

items.explain: flexible = linh hoạt. Example: A part-time job with flexible hours suits students.
passionate about = đam mê. Example: My sister is passionate about photography.

steps.title: Step 2 · Trend grammar: past simple and prepositions (3 min)
steps.instructions: Complete the sentences about a line graph. Write ONE word in each gap: the past simple of the verb in brackets, or a preposition (from, to, by, at).

items.label: 1. In 2010, the figure for buses ______ (stand) at 40%.
2. The percentage of students who cycled ______ (rise) from 15% to 35%.
3. Car use ______ (fall) sharply over the period.
4. The figure for buses increased ______ 40% ______ 50%. (two words)
5. Car use dropped ______ 30 percentage points in 15 years.
6. In 2025, the bus figure was the highest, ______ 50%.

steps.title: Step 3 · Writing: intro + overview (9 min)
steps.instructions: The line graph shows the percentage of students at a university who travelled to campus by bus, bicycle and car in 2010, 2015, 2020 and 2025. Data: Bus 40, 42, 45, 50 · Bicycle 15, 20, 28, 35 · Car 45, 38, 27, 15. Write the Intro + Overview (about 60 words). Checklist: intro paraphrases what, who, where and when · overview has 2 sentences (main trends + biggest change or highest figure) · no numbers in the overview · past simple. Support: The line graph illustrates the proportion of … who … between … and … · Overall, … while … · It is also clear that … Challenge: add one Body sentence with stood at and from … to.

open.model: The line graph illustrates the proportion of university students who travelled to campus by bus, bicycle and car between 2010 and 2025. Overall, the percentages of students who took the bus or cycled increased, while car use fell considerably. It is also clear that the car was the most popular choice at the start of the period, but the bus was the most common way to travel by the end.

steps.title: Step 4 · Voice note: read your Overview (30 s)
steps.instructions: Record yourself reading your Overview aloud, about 30 seconds. Say the final sounds clearly (-ed, -s).
steps.note: Thầy nghe âm cuối và thì quá khứ.
